 Prakash Singh Kushwaha
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Ms. Vidhi Singh - Advocate for applicant.
 Shri Amit Pandey - Panel Lawyer for State.

Order 
This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.210/2023 registered at Police Station - Semariya, District Rewa (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Section 420, 409 of the Indian Penal Code and 3, 7 of Essential Commodities Act.
Applicant is in detention since 21.05.2024.
2. As per the prosecution story, allegation against the applicant is that applicant used to illegally use the food grains for his own benefit.
On the basis of aforesaid, the said case was registered against the present applicant under the aforesaid Sections.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 21.05.2024.
Applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
Charge sheet has been filed.
The applicant is ready to deposit Rs.2,25,000/- under protest.
Applicant has no criminal antecedents.
The trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail pending the trial.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant.
5. Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently, bail application under Section 439 of the Code o f Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed on the condition that applicant shall deposit the amount of Rs.2,25,000/-
under protest which shall be deposited in the FDR till final judgment and shall not be disbursed to anyone.
